stem: A nurse is handling contaminated linen in a patient-care area. Which action is appropriate?

options.A: Sort contaminated linen in the client room before bagging so heavily soiled pieces can be separated early.
options.B: Handle the linen with minimum agitation and contain it at the point of use, using leak-resistant containment when blood or body substances could soak through.
options.C: Shake contaminated linen before bagging to remove loose material and reduce the laundry load.
options.D: Prerinse contaminated linen in the patient-care area before placing it in the transport container.

rationale: Current CDC environmental infection-control recommendations direct healthcare personnel to handle contaminated textiles with minimum agitation, bag or otherwise contain them at the point of use, avoid sorting or prerinsing them in patient-care areas, and use leak-resistant containment for textiles contaminated with blood or body substances when leakage or soak-through is possible. Therefore B is correct. A and D perform prohibited sorting/prerinsing in the care area, while C increases agitation and potential aerosolization/dispersion of contaminated material.
educational_objective: Handle contaminated healthcare linen with minimum agitation, contain it at the point of use, avoid sorting or prerinsing it in patient-care areas, and use leak-resistant containment when indicated.

audit_findings.claim_audit: Final item uses explicit CDC handling requirements and preserves the conditional nature of leak-resistant containment without adding unsupported laundry-processing parameters.

distractor_audit.A: Incorrect because sorting contaminated textiles in patient-care areas is not recommended/permitted.
distractor_audit.C: Incorrect because shaking increases agitation and potential dispersion of contaminants.
distractor_audit.D: Incorrect because contaminated linen should not be prerinised in patient-care areas.

audit_findings.ambiguity_second_answer: Only B satisfies all CDC handling requirements without adding a prohibited patient-care-area step.
audit_findings.cueing: All options are linen-handling actions within the same workflow and are parallel in scope.
